usage: cox stats gates [-h] [--db DB] [--since SINCE] [--store] [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR]
                       [--min-sample MIN_SAMPLE] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --db DB
  --since SINCE         keep only rows dated on or after DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)
  --store               read task and call rows from the run store instead of stats.db
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR   the run store's directory, with --store
  --min-sample MIN_SAMPLE
                        decided tasks a role needs before it is judged, else 'not enough data'
                        (default 50)
  --json
